notes.title: EmyLive Cosmic Collection: Alien Love & Hot Witnesses bundle
notes.content:
With a new collaboration between TeamEmily and BLUESHROOM GAMES, we would like to introduce a bundle that allows you to buy both games together for a special price: 

https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/51731/EmyLive_Cosmic_Collection_Alien_Love__Hot_Witnesses/

Let's enjoy these fun detective and adventure games together!

notes.title: New EmyLiveShow Game
notes.content:
Immerse yourself in the atmosphere of a small mystical town and make acquaintances that will inspire an unusual book! 
There are 4 different romantic interests in the game: the vampire Emy, the cool girl Nia, the cute mystic Uma and the elegant alien Six.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3137500/EmyLiveShow_How_To_Write_A_Bestseller/

notes.title: 1.0.4 Fix
notes.content: Main character renaming, stat earning, and Steam achievements should now work correctly

notes.title: Controller support and new localizations!
notes.content:
- Controller support added
- Two new languages added: Simplified Chinese and Japanese

notes.title: Card game in the EmyLiveShow series
notes.content:
Our team continues to experiment with new genres and plots. Arm yourself with a deck of cards to battle the four villains who threaten your quiet life!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3089340/EmyLiveShow_BossRush/
